title: Action Songs
text:
Action songs help children learn English. In the song Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes, you touch each part of your body. The song is fun and easy to sing.

Children sing and move together in class. They jump, clap, and turn around. Teachers use action songs every day.

questions.text: What do you touch in the song Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes?
What do children do in class?

options: They are fun and help children learn

questions.text: How do the children probably feel during an action song?

vocabulary.definition: to put your hand on something
to hit your hands together to make a sound

paragraph_translations: Las canciones de acción ayudan a los niños a aprender inglés. En la canción Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes, tocas cada parte de tu cuerpo. La canción es divertida y fácil de cantar.
Los niños cantan y se mueven juntos en clase. Saltan, aplauden y dan vueltas. Los profesores usan canciones de acción todos los días.
